comparability_rows.external_track: GeoBench question set released on Hugging Face
comparability_rows.reason_en: both freeze their evaluation sets with published provenance; ours is additionally content-fingerprint-locked
both grade deterministically without judge models
we are not a generative LLM; no run was performed and no score is claimed

comparability_rows.external_track: 939 subjective questions, 50 scored with human evaluation
comparability_rows.reason_en: human-judged generative scoring does not apply to a retrieval-only platform

comparability_rows.internal_track: 10 unanswerable + 5 fake-reference probes, refusal gate at 1.0 in every audit run
comparability_rows.reason_en: GeoBench measures accuracy only; honest refusal is our gated track

comparability_rows.internal_track: every internal pass must cite a stored doc id with a required evidence term
comparability_rows.reason_en: citation-locked answers are native to our grader contract

comparability_rows.external_track: scores depend on model weights and judge models
comparability_rows.reason_en: our evidence chain reproduces identically on two independent systems
the external benchmark is ~45.8x larger; announced honestly, not hidden
external sources are broader; our corpus growth is gated on licensed partnerships

comparability_rows.internal_track: Arabic-first golden questions with English negative probes
comparability_rows.reason_en: both are multilingual evaluation sets over different language pairs

composition.verbatim_quote_en: In GeoBench, we collect 183 multiple-choice questions in NPEE, and 1,395 in AP Test, for objective tasks. Meanwhile, we gather all 939 subjective questions in NPEE to be the subjective tasks set and use 50 to measure the baselines with human evaluation.

external_benchmark.introduced_in_paper: K2: A Foundation Language Model for Geoscience Knowledge Understanding and Utilization (arXiv:2306.05064v2)
external_benchmark.name: GeoBench
external_benchmark.position_en: the first NLP benchmark in geoscience: objective multiple-choice questions plus subjective questions

redistribution_posture.reason_ar: الرخصة Apache-2.0 تسمح نظرياً، لكن عقيدة النظافة وغياب أي مسار توليدي MCQ في منصتنا يجعلان إعادة توزيع الأسئلة بلا أي فائدة قياسية — المحاذاة بنيوية وأرقام داخلية مقاسة: لا نسخ أسئلة ولا درجات مُدَّعاة.

reference_points.k2_model_en: K2 (7B): LLaMA-7B further pretrained on 3.9 billion tokens of cleaned geoscience literature, then aligned with GeoSignal supervised data (upstream README, accessed 2026-11-23).
reference_points.score_usage_note_ar: لا نُقاس هنا أمام GeoBench ولا نستشهد بأرقام دقة K2 وكأنها أرقامنا — تشغيل أسئلتهم على منصتنا غير مُنفَّذ ولا يُدَّعى.

sources.note_en: code released under Apache License 2.0 (upstream README)

note_ar: ملف المحاذاة الخارجية المجمّد: حقائق GeoBench المنشورة بأرقامها الحرفية من مصادرها الأصلية مع تاريخ الوصول، وبصفوف قابلية مقارنة تصنّف بصدق أين نتطابق وأين نقصر. لا سؤال امتحاني واحد منسوخ هنا — المحاذاة بنيوية وبأرقام داخلية مقاسة فقط، وكل رقم يحمل مصدره.
unmapped_note_ar: مجالا الاستكشاف والنمذجة ثلاثية الأبعاد عندنا بلا مقابل في مواضيع GeoBench الثلاثة — التغطية ليست في اتجاه واحد، وهذا يُعلن بصدق.
